messages:
Nora Chen: hey all — first day and my MacBook Pro (M2) finished Kandji enrollment but i never got a FileVault prompt. my login is still showing a local account. any quick checks? :grimacing:

IT Support: welcome Nora! can you confirm if you were docked during first boot and what macOS version? also please run `sudo fdesetup status` and paste output.

Nora Chen: plugged into the company USB-C dock at my desk. macOS 14.3. output: 'FileVault is Off'.

Kandji-bot: Enrollment complete for "Nora Chen - MacBookPro15" at 2026-09-05T08:11:22Z. Applied profile: "New Hire - Mac".

Jordan (Device Admin): thanks. we occasionally see docks delay network bring-up so the recovery escrow step fails if the escrow agent can't talk to our Okta/KMS endpoints. two options: (1) enable FileVault locally now with `sudo fdesetup enable -user "nora.chen"` and then we'll run Kandji's SyncRecoveryKey action, or (2) unplug dock, reboot to wifi, re-run enrollment to let it escrow automatically. which would you prefer?

Nora Chen: i'd rather not re-enroll. i'll do the command if you confirm the exact steps (i'm not totally comfy with recovery keys).

Jordan (Device Admin): absolutely — run these in Terminal:

```
sudo fdesetup enable -user "nora.chen"
# follow prompts and choose 'Institutional recovery key' when asked
```
After you finish, message here and i'll trigger `kandjictl runAction --device "C02N0RA12345" --action SyncRecoveryKey` from the console. i'll be standing by.

Nora Chen: running now... prompted for password, then asked to choose recovery key type. i picked institutional. done.

Jordan (Device Admin): initiating SyncRecoveryKey...

Network Bot: Note: Packet capture shows docked link negotiated ~20s after login, which can be too late for early init jobs. Recommend adding a KB note and option for MAC-based DHCP onboarding exception.

Kandji-bot: Recovery escrow succeeded for device serial C02N0RA12345 at 2026-09-05T08:23:12Z. Device record updated in Okta.

IT Support: confirmed FileVault is On for Nora and Okta device now present. Jordan — can you add a short item to the new-hires checklist about docks + FV?

Jordan (Device Admin): will add KB: "If using dock during first boot, unplug until enrollment & escrow complete or enable FV manually and run SyncRecoveryKey." I'll open a ticket for networking to consider a DHCP onboarding exception for new devices.

Nora Chen: thanks everyone! super quick turnaround :clap:
